explication: Tiny RDM is a cross-platform Redis desktop manager with a deployable web mode. Users configure connections, browse databases and keys, inspect or edit values, and use operational tools such as monitoring, CLI, slow logs, and pub/sub. The graph reflects the documented capabilities and the sampled frontend composition; backend internals and several frontend-to-backend links were not shown in excerpts, so those relationships are omitted or marked unverified.
